prompt: Create a premium promotional background visual for temaru, a Japanese listing tool for online resellers. Palette: deep navy, royal blue, bright sky blue, with small warm gold accents. Clean, modern, cinematic, high-end. No people, no characters, no hands. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or readable UI labels. Product cards may show items only. Scene direction: Vertical poster background. In the UPPER HALF: a floating translucent blue-glass browser window, slightly tilted in 3D perspective, showing a neat grid of luxury fashion product cards (leather handbag, white sneakers, sunglasses, watch, scarf) each with a small green check mark, product photos look like the reference. A few product cards fly into the window along a bright cyan light trail with sparkles. Background: night city skyline at blue hour seen from high above, glass skyscrapers, deep navy, a bright luminous sky glow behind the window, diagonal light rays. The LOWER 45% is calm deep navy with soft bokeh and gentle gradient, empty, good for overlaying large text. High contrast, premium advertising style.
